description: Authored new-text probes. These descriptions are not in the training snapshot. Topic labels are test expectations, not inferred from model outputs.

probes.text: A saxophone quartet improvises over blues changes and swing standards in an intimate listening room.
Piano, upright bass and drums explore bebop compositions in a live trio concert.
Learn to center wet clay on a spinning wheel and shape your own bowl, then glaze and fire it.
Build a vase using clay coils and slabs in a hands-on handbuilding workshop.
Bring binoculars for a guided walk identifying migrating warblers by their calls and plumage.
Observe herons and shorebirds with naturalists along the marsh, learning field identification techniques.
A gentle practice of sun salutations, standing poses, mindful breathing and a final resting posture.
Join an instructor for a slow vinyasa flow with guided breathwork and modifications for beginners.
An architect leads a walking tour of modernist buildings, explaining their facades, structural systems and floor plans.
Study the restoration of an Art Deco skyscraper, from its original blueprints to the preservation of its historic lobby.
An independent singer-songwriter performs intimate acoustic songs inspired by landscapes and rural life, with fingerpicked guitar and close harmonies.
An evening of contemporary folk songwriting from an independent acoustic duo, with banjo, guitar and vocal harmonies.
A lecture on African American civil rights organizing, followed by discussion of Black historical figures and their continuing legacy.
Explore the Harlem Renaissance through the poetry, art and political ideas of Black writers and artists.
